contentText:
"I was hoping we were going to have a bigger crowd than this, especially with the nice weather and everything," Michael Maria told me. "I'm a little disappointed because the last march, I think there were about 10 times as many people at this time of day."

At 11AM, the crowd at Portland's downtown waterfront appeared thinner than it had during the last No Kings protest in October. Some of this was to be expected. In the autumn of 2025, Portland had been at the center of the storm. President Donald Trump had called the city "war-ravaged."
